operations.name: Get alerts
operations.description: Get a list of alerts for a given scope

responses.description: Invalid user input received. See error details for further information.
Unauthorized access - please sign in and retry.

query.name: accountIds
query.description: List of Account IDs to filter by. Example: "225494730938493804,225494730938493915".

query.name: analystVerdict
query.description: Filter threats by a analyst verdict. Example: "TRUE_POSITIVE".

query.name: containerImageName__contains
query.description: Free-text filter by the endpoint container image name (supports multiple values)

query.name: containerLabels__contains
query.description: Free-text filter by the endpoint container labels (supports multiple values)

query.name: containerName__contains
query.description: Free-text filter by the endpoint container name (supports multiple values)

query.name: countOnly
query.description: If true, only total number of items will be returned, without any of the actual objects.

query.name: createdAt__gt
query.description: Created at greater than. Example: "2018-02-27T04:49:26.257525Z".

query.name: createdAt__gte
query.description: Created at greater or equal than. Example: "2018-02-27T04:49:26.257525Z".

query.name: createdAt__lt
query.description: Created at lesser than. Example: "2018-02-27T04:49:26.257525Z".

query.name: createdAt__lte
query.description: Created at lesser or equal than. Example: "2018-02-27T04:49:26.257525Z".

query.name: cursor
query.description: Cursor position returned by the last request. Use to iterate over more than 1000 items. Example: "YWdlbnRfaWQ6NTgwMjkzODE=".

query.name: disablePagination
query.description: If true, all rules for requested scope will be returned

query.name: groupIds
query.description: List of Group IDs to filter by. Example: "225494730938493804,225494730938493915".

query.name: incidentStatus
query.description: Filter threats by a incident status. Example: "IN_PROGRESS".

query.name: k8sCluster__contains
query.description: Free-text filter by the endpoint Kubernetes cluster name (supports multiple values)

query.name: k8sControllerLabels__contains
query.description: Free-text filter by the endpoint Kubernetes controller labels (supports multiple values)

query.name: k8sControllerName__contains
query.description: Free-text filter by the endpoint Kubernetes controller name (supports multiple values)

query.name: k8sNamespaceLabels__contains
query.description: Free-text filter by the endpoint Kubernetes namespace labels (supports multiple values)

query.name: k8sNamespaceName__contains
query.description: Free-text filter by the endpoint Kubernetes namespace name (supports multiple values)

query.name: k8sNode__contains
query.description: Free-text filter by the endpoint Kubernetes node name (supports multiple values)

query.name: k8sPod__contains
query.description: Free-text filter by the endpoint Kubernetes pod name (supports multiple values)

query.name: k8sPodLabels__contains
query.description: Free-text filter by the endpoint Kubernetes pod labels (supports multiple values)

query.name: limit
query.description: Limit number of returned items (1-1000). Example: "10".

query.name: machineType
query.description: agent machine type

query.name: origAgentName__contains
query.description: Free-text filter by agent name. Example: "ilia".

query.name: origAgentOsRevision__contains
query.description: Free-text filter by agent OS revision. Example: "win7".

query.name: origAgentUuid__contains
query.description: Free-text filter by agent UUID. Example: "win7".

query.name: origAgentVersion__contains
query.description: Free-text filter by agent OS version. Example: "7.11".

query.name: osType
query.description: Included OS types

query.name: query
query.description: Full text search for all fields

query.name: reportedAt__gt
query.description: Reported at greater than. Example: "2018-02-27T04:49:26.257525Z".

query.name: reportedAt__gte
query.description: Reported at greater or equal than. Example: "2018-02-27T04:49:26.257525Z".

query.name: reportedAt__lt
query.description: Reported at lesser than. Example: "2018-02-27T04:49:26.257525Z".

query.name: reportedAt__lte
query.description: Reported at lesser or equal than. Example: "2018-02-27T04:49:26.257525Z".

query.name: ruleName__contains
query.description: Free-text filter by rule name. Example: "rule1".

query.name: scopes
query.description: Filter results by scope. Example: "group".

query.name: severity
query.description: Severity. Example: "Low".

query.name: siteIds
query.description: List of Site IDs to filter by. Example: "225494730938493804,225494730938493915".

query.name: skip
query.description: Skip first number of items (0-1000). To iterate over more than 1000 items,  use "cursor". Example: "150".

query.name: skipCount
query.description: If true, total number of items will not be calculated, which speeds up execution time.

query.name: sortBy
query.description: The column to sort the results by. Example: "id".

query.name: sortOrder
query.description: Sort direction. Example: "asc".

query.name: sourceProcessCommandline__contains
query.description: Free-text filter by source commandline. Example: "rule1".

query.name: sourceProcessFileHashMd5__contains
query.description: Free-text filter by source md5. Example: "rule1".

query.name: sourceProcessFileHashSha1__contains
query.description: Free-text filter by source sha1. Example: "rule1".

query.name: sourceProcessFileHashSha256__contains
query.description: Free-text filter by source sha255. Example: "rule1".

query.name: sourceProcessFilePath__contains
query.description: Free-text filter by source file path. Example: "rule1".

query.name: sourceProcessName__contains
query.description: Free-text filter by source process name. Example: "proc1.exe".

query.name: sourceProcessStoryline__contains
query.description: Free-text filter by source storyline. Example: "rule1".

query.name: sourceProcessStoryline__equals
query.description: Filter by exact source storyline. Example: "3F2504E0-4F89-41D3-9A0C-0305E82C3301".

query.name: tenant
query.description: Indicates a tenant scope request
